exposure: timing of IUD insertion (during elective LSCS vs. six weeks postpartum)
Timing of IUD insertion (during elective LSCS vs. 6 weeks postpartum)
Group II (IUD insertion 6 weeks or more after LSCS)
cohort: 200 women planned for elective cesarean delivery who desired an IUD as contraception
finding: IUD insertion during elective LSCS was associated with a significantly lower incidence of failed insertion and uterine perforation compared to insertion 6 weeks postpartum.
